programmes.d: Robert Davis, who was convicted of murdering a woman and her son, claims his confession was coerced and tries to prove he is innocent.
A mother searches for answers in the unsolved murder of her 14-year-old daughter until new DNA technology changes everything.

A Philadelphia murder reveals decades of misconduct in the city's criminal justice system and raises questions about whether police caught the right person; key insiders in the case speak out for the first time on national television.
A young art student from Texas is found murdered in her bed with no sign of forced entry, indicating that she knew her killer.
The murder of former NBA star and hometown hero Lorenzen Wright sends shockwaves through the city of Memphis; insiders speak out about new developments in the lengthy search for justice.
When Dr. Teresa Sievers is found murdered in her kitchen, detectives struggle to find any leads until an unexpected tip changes everything; the woman who helped investigators speaks out.
After a young Army veteran disappears, detectives uncover a cryptic 911 call placed 11 days before she went missing, which exposes a twisted story -- and the truth.
Two tenacious sisters determined to fulfill a promise investigate the mystery surrounding their mother's death.
Key players in the case of Rod Covlin, a New York man who is found guilty of murdering his wife for her $5.3 million fortune and attempting to frame his then-teenage daughter, share their stories.
Police investigate whether the murder of a South Florida attorney is connected to a web of fraud, betrayal and more than $1 billion in missing money.
A man steals millions of dollars by conning numerous women and businesses over 25 years; one woman brings together a group of his victims to hold him accountable and make him face justice.

A deadly high-speed chase in Montana leads "Dateline" on a search through 50 years of history to unravel the mystery of how one man turned into a monster and committed one of the state's most notorious crimes.
When a mother of four dies unexpectedly on Valentine's Day, her death is attributed to natural causes, but a detective suspects that someone murdered the woman.
A father is accused of stealing money from his children's trust funds and murdering his ex-wife to cover up his crimes.
San Diego detectives investigate the deaths of a young woman and her 10-month-old child.
Pamela Smart's husband is found murdered; police investigate and discover that Smart is keeping a big secret.
Using DNA testing and a photographer's diary, a retired detective reopens a cold case involving the death of a beautiful young mother.
When a pharmacist is found shot to death in his Wisconsin farmhouse, investigators embark on a 15-year hunt for his elusive killer.
When a complicated Texas love triangle ends in murder, a pink gun leads to an arrest, until new evidence prompts investigators to rethink the case.
When a dog trainer with celebrity clientele disappears, investigators track down a suspect with the help of two witnesses.

A mystery in paradise unfolds when Sarm Heslop vanishes from her boyfriend's luxury yacht in the U.S. Virgin Islands; new details emerge on the case that made international headlines and left investigators with more questions than answers.
Investigators look for answers when a popular school superintendent is found dead in his western New York home.
